The Lantern
[1] Spring
A girl hangs a paper lantern on the gate. The wind turns it slowly. She does not light it.
"Will you light it?"
Nobody answers. The lantern is red.
[2] Summer
The lantern has faded to pink. I take it down and fold it into a drawer.
[3] Winter
I open the drawer. The lantern is still folded. I light it for the first time.
